name: Advance Veterinary Diets Renal (dog, dry)
note: Manufacturer label, per 100 g as fed: protein 16.5%, fat 17.5%, fibre 3.5%, ash 4.5%, Ca 0.65%, P 0.3%, K 0.7%, Na 0.25%, omega-3 0.7%, omega-6 2.9%. Moisture and energy not declared: energy estimated (modified Atwater, 8% moisture assumed) = 382 kcal/100 g, so per-1000 kcal values are approximate. Omega-6 used as linoleic acid. Omega-3 0.7% is total (fish oil + plant), EPA+DHA not declared. Vitamins and trace minerals are ADDED amounts per kg (ingredients add more): vit A 27,000 IU, D3 600 IU, E 600 mg, Fe 86 mg, Cu 8.8 mg, Mn 40 mg, Zn 148 mg, I 1.4 mg, Se 0.1 mg. Retailer listings (e.g. zooplus) show an older label (protein 14.5%, Ca 0.8%, K 0.6%, D3 1800 IU).
